  • Method Details

    • implement

      public void implement(Class<?> token, Path root) throws info.kgeorgiy.ja.fedoseev.implementor.exception.ImplerIOException, info.kgeorgiy.ja.fedoseev.implementor.exception.InvalidParentException
      Produces code implementing class or interface specified by provided token.

      Generated class' name should be the same as the class name of the type token with Impl suffix added. Generated source code should be placed in the correct subdirectory of the specified root directory and have correct file name. For example, the implementation of the interface List should go to $root/java/util/ListImpl.java

      Specified by:
      implement in interface info.kgeorgiy.java.advanced.implementor.Impler
      Parameters:
      token - type token to create implementation for.
      root - root directory.
      Throws:
      info.kgeorgiy.ja.fedoseev.implementor.exception.ImplerIOException - If IOException occurred.
      info.kgeorgiy.ja.fedoseev.implementor.exception.InvalidParentException - If class can't be implemented.

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      The entry point of the application.

      This method allows running the code generation or JAR archive creation from the command line. Depending on the provided arguments, the program either generates the implementation source code (.java) or packages it directly into a .jar file.

      Parameters:
      args - command-line arguments. Two or three arguments are expected:
      • For generating a .java file: <fully_qualified_class_name> <root_directory_path>
      • For generating a .jar file: -jar <fully_qualified_class_name> <jar_file_path>

      Produces .jar file implementing class or interface specified by provided token.
